task: T3: add the Job renderer to scripts/dispatch/dispatcher.py. Define `render_job(intent, *, image, namespace, run_id)` returning a Kubernetes Job object as a plain Python dict — do not emit YAML text, and do not import a Kubernetes client. `apiVersion` is `batch/v1` and `kind` is `Job`. The object must set, every time and not conditionally: the given namespace; a name derived from the run id; `spec.activeDeadlineSeconds` and `spec.ttlSecondsAfterFinished` to positive integers taken from module-level constants; `spec.backoffLimit` of 0, because the loop owns retries and a Kubernetes retry would start a second loop over the same spec; a pod `nodeSelector` of exactly `{"harness-fleet": "true"}`; the container image set from the `image` argument; and container env entries carrying the intent's repo, spec and strategy under the names REPO, SPEC and STRATEGY. Every one of those bounds exists because loop Jobs share the cluster with DNS and media, so none of them may be omitted or made optional.
